problem: A transactional website flow linked from a public page was not registered as a functional utility route.
root_cause: The technical SEO gate correctly rejected a link whose target was outside the indexable route inventory.
change: Registered /behoeftecheck as a public utility route
Added noindex,follow to the transactional form
prevention: Every non-indexable public flow linked from indexable pages must be registered in PUBLIC_UTILITY_ROUTES and carry an explicit robots directive.
evidence: Pagina- en SEO-controle succeeds with /behoeftecheck registered as a public utility route
The form page declares noindex,follow and keeps the canonical /behoeftecheck URL
Exact Netlify production build parity and immutable preview are required before promotion
